'''Don Anzalone''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Tempe tournament (17 June)]] on 17 June 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] and Hidden Beats (like Brentson's beats), according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d913">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-tempe-az-6-17-00d913/ tempe-az-6-17-00], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-tempe-az-6-17-00d913/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
